scope: Public human-annotated response-support component; not current-reader generation, PDF end-to-end accuracy or a production release guarantee
selection: One deterministic response per source; source IDs and context hashes disjoint across splits; no quality or support-label filtering

models.license: Apache-2.0; model license does not clear upstream data rights

unsupported_label: At least one original annotated span, including implicit_true factual-but-unsupported spans. No labels generated here.
quality_labels: Incorrect refusal and truncation reported separately; never used for routing or cohort selection
selection_rule: Calibration only: maximum released count among corrected exact-bound qualifiers, then lower bound, higher threshold, lower model index, smaller depth, numeric guard on
stratified_rule: Require a qualifying bound separately in all three task strata; report pooled and strict selections separately
assumptions: Binomial bounds require independent matched-distribution examples; source disjointness does not remove task or PDF domain shift
licensing_notes: Repository MIT license retained in private source cache
QA derives from MS MARCO with noncommercial research terms; other original source rights are not cleared by a repository/model license
Raw source text and responses remain outside Git; publish numeric results, IDs, hashes and citations only
